name: OpenVibe.Tips

site.name: Tips
site.tagline: Tips, paid messages and alerts for any stream
site.what: A tip page and alert kit for creators on any platform: tips, paid messages, text-to-speech and media requests, goals and OBS overlays, settled by the network’s billing ledger.
site.description: OpenVibe.Tips gives every creator a tip page at openvibe.tips/<name> and an alert kit for their stream, wherever they stream: supporters send a tip, a highlighted paid message, a message read out on stream or a video request, within the creator’s own limits, and an overlay link shows each one in OBS as it lands, next to the creator’s goals. It works for OpenVibe.Live, Twitch, YouTube and Kick alike. Payments settle in OpenVibe.Billing, and every receipt shows separately when the payment settled and when the message was delivered.

faq.question: Do I need to stream on OpenVibe.Live?
faq.answer: No. Your tip page works as a link anywhere, and the overlay is a browser source for OBS, so it shows alerts on Twitch, YouTube or Kick too. On OpenVibe.Live, tips also appear in your chat with your alert sound.

faq.question: How do supporters pay?
faq.answer: In Vibes from their OpenVibe balance (100 Vibes = $1), or through a checkout OpenVibe.Billing offers. Billing settles every payment; Tips never holds money.

faq.question: What do supporters have to send?
faq.answer: A new page starts at 1 Vibe for a tip, 100 for a paid message or text-to-speech and 25 for a media request. You set your own minimums, and you choose whether text-to-speech and media requests are on.

faq.question: How do I get the money?
faq.answer: Tips arrive as Vibes you can cash out, under the network’s cash-out rules (from 500 Vibes, after a 14-day hold).

liveness.means: the process answers and reports the outbox status from its database; it checks no dependency (Billing and the Network key are what ready checks)

drains: outbox relay and Network key refresh stopped
HTTP server closed, then the database

resumes.what: pending chat effects are delivered again with retries; due Billing transfers of funded checkouts are sent again
overlay deliveries past their window are marked failed
OpenVibe.Events redelivers billing.transaction.settled, billing.transaction.reversed and billing.receipt.external that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each export and deletion once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns the ov_tips PostgreSQL database; an effect moves with a compare-and-set on its state in one transaction

notes: Creator support (roadmap Wave 9): tip interactions whose payment state mirrors OpenVibe.Billing (keyed by Billing transaction id) and whose delivery state is Tips' own; goals derived from settled interactions; paid messages, TTS and media requests created on settlement; scoped revocable overlay tokens with SSE overlays; simulation mode. Tips never moves money (ADR-012). Alpha: deployed internally (loopback only), not launched publicly: openvibe.tips serves the OpenVibe.Sites placeholder until the launch rule in README.md holds.
